prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
competitors_mentioned: AI marketing agency in Los Angeles
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on what you need (performance advertising, personalization, creative generation, analytics, CRM, data engineering, etc.), your industry, budget, and timeline. Tell me a bit about your goals and I can recommend a tight shortlist. Meanwhile, here are reputable firms (global and U.S.) that do strong AI-driven marketing work and either have Los Angeles presence or serve LA clients:

- Accenture Song — consultative, enterprise-scale AI + marketing technology integrations, good for complex omnichannel transformation.  
- Deloitte Digital — strong on data, analytics, and AI strategy plus enterprise implementation and measurement.  
- R/GA — creative and product-focused agency that blends AI/engineering with brand and customer experience work.  
- Merkle (Dentsu) — specializes in data-driven personalization, CRM, and AI-powered customer journeys.  
- Ogilvy — global creative agency with AI-enabled capabilities across content, media, and CX.  
- VaynerMedia — digital-first agency that pairs performance media with AI-enabled creative and social analytics (works with enterprise and mid-market).  
- Persado — AI platform focused on marketing language (subject lines, ad copy) to boost conversion through NLP.  
- Phrasee — AI for email and messaging language optimization and automation.

How to pick:
- Define the outcome (e.g., increase ROAS, automate creative copy/video, personalize site/email, build in-house AI ops).  
- Ask for case studies and metrics from similar industries.  
- Check their tech stack and integrations (CDP, MMPs, ad platforms, CMS).  
- Evaluate data governance and privacy practices (critical in consumer-facing work).  
- Start with a small paid pilot or proof-of-concept before a long contract.

If you tell me: (1) your objective, (2) budget, and (3) whether you’re enterprise or startup, I’ll recommend a 2–3 agency shortlist tailored to you and sample vetting questions to ask each.
